summary: One-frame result of a mod.io download/install (client only, registry total 360). ls::PublishingSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0; Toolkit GameEngine.dll ls::PublishingSystem::Process*Requests) creates it on a new entity from a request queued by the matching HandleUGC... callback of the mod.io back-end; the same frame also gets a UGCRequestResultOneFrameComponent with the net::UGCResult and request Guid. Request queue filled by HandleUGCFileInstalled(unsigned __int64, net::PublishModInfo const&, net::UGCResult, ls::Path const&, bool); drained by bg3.exe+0x3BDFA70 (request stride 0x1A0: id +0, UGCResult +8, Path +0x30, PublishModInfo +0x48, bool +0x188, Guid after).
